web.steeredNewTurn: The turn had finished; your message started a new one.
web.tasksIntro: Background jobs, sub-agents and workflows this server is running. Refreshes every few seconds.
web.skillsIntro: Skills loaded for this workspace. Enable or disable them with /skills in the terminal; a user-invocable one runs from the composer as /name.
web.agentsIntro: Sub-agent definitions the Agent tool can spawn (built-ins, ~/.rebon/agents, .rebon/agents, plugins).
web.mcpIntro: MCP servers this server started and the tools they expose.
web.reportsIntro: These run on the server and answer into the transcript.
web.rewindIntro: Restore the conversation to the state at a previous user message; the rewound-away prompt comes back into the composer.
web.rewindFilesNote: File restore is not available over rebon serve (this surface keeps no file-history snapshots); use rebon in the terminal for files.
web.rewindStopFirst: Stop the running turn before rewinding.
web.rewindConfirm: Rewind the conversation to this point? This cannot be undone.
web.modelsIntro: Models for provider {p}. The choice applies to the open session and is remembered as the default.
web.helpIntro: Type / in the composer to pick one. Commands that only make sense in a terminal (/provider, /onboarding…) say so when typed.
web.accentDesc: The same three accents as the desktop app.
web.openSessionFirst: Open a session to change its options.
web.noEntries: kernelPlugins configures no entries. Add dsh packages under kernelPlugins in config.json and restart rebon serve.
web.switchableAgents: Agents this session can switch to
web.switchHint: Pick one in the composer tray or with /agent <id>; the choice belongs to the current session.
web.noTokenBody: Open the URL printed by rebon serve — it carries the per-run token this page needs to reach the agent.
web.keyTab: Complete the highlighted command or file
web.keyEsc: Close a panel · stop the turn
web.unknownCommand: Unknown command /{n}. Type / to see what is available.
web.attachTooBig: {n}: images over 8 MB are not sent.
web.fileTooBig: {n}: files over 1 MB are not attached; mention the path instead.
web.noImages: This agent does not accept images.
web.moreMatches: More matches — keep typing to narrow.
web.alreadyAnswered: This request was already answered in another tab.
web.usageNote: Counted from this server's own turns; earlier turns are not on record.
mobile.updateAvailableBody: Rebon Mobile {version} is available. Download the universal Android APK in your browser?
mobile.updateAvailableBodyAbi: Rebon Mobile {version} is available. Download the {abi} Android APK for this device in your browser?
mobile.updateBrowserOpenFailed: Unable to open the browser. Try again later.
mobile.languageSystemDescription: Use Chinese for Chinese system locales, otherwise English
mobile.dynamicIslandSectionHint: Customize the native compact surface on Android 16.1+ and iOS 16.1+
mobile.dynamicIslandShowTitleDescription: Keep the Rebon icon and a truncated session title in the compact surface
mobile.dynamicIslandRotateSessionsDescri: Switch the title and matching status every 6 seconds when several sessions are active
mobile.dynamicIslandRotateSessionsRequir: Requires session titles to be enabled
mobile.dynamicIslandShowActivityDescript: Show short labels such as Edit, Read, Agent, or Bash in the status chip
mobile.dynamicIslandShowTimerDescription: Show the selected session's elapsed timer when the system has space
mobile.defaultPermissionHint: Automatic approval policy for new sessions
mobile.permissionDefaultDescription: Sensitive operations still request confirmation based on desktop settings
mobile.permissionAutoDescription: Not recommended · New sessions can run operations without confirmation
mobile.settingsDefaultsNotice: These defaults apply to new sessions and can be overridden per session. API keys stay on the connected device.
mobile.settingsUnavailable: Connect to a desktop version that supports new-session configuration
mobile.activitySubtitle: Token usage over the last 13 weeks
mobile.launcherTargetUnavailable: This shortcut target is no longer available. Reconfigure the widget.
mobile.deviceCredentialsNotice: Pairing credentials are encrypted in secure system storage and used to reconnect after launch. Conversations and task resources are not persisted; forgetting a device deletes its saved credentials.
mobile.onboardingWelcomeBody: Stay in control of coding agents on your desktop: view sessions, track tasks, answer questions, and approve requests from anywhere.
mobile.onboardingEncryptionBody: Your phone and desktop communicate through a relay with end-to-end encryption. The relay cannot read your sessions or code.
mobile.onboardingConnectBody: Open Settings › Devices on desktop and scan the QR code with your phone. Rebon reconnects automatically afterward.
mobile.noRealSessionsDescription: Start a session on desktop or create one from the button above.
mobile.connectDesktopDescription: Go to Me and scan the desktop QR code. Projects and sessions will appear here securely.
mobile.noSessionsInProject: No sessions in this project yet
mobile.projectOfflineDescription: The desktop is offline. Files and terminal are temporarily unavailable. File contents are not cached on this phone.
mobile.projectUnavailableDescription: This project is no longer in the desktop state. Return to Sessions and choose another project.
mobile.homeLayoutHint: How the sessions tab organizes your work
mobile.homeLayoutSessionFirstDescription: Grouped by state — needs input, in progress, archived. Projects become a filter.
mobile.homeLayoutProjectGroupedDescripti: The classic layout: one collapsible section per project.
mobile.sessionStateChanged: The session state changed. Refresh and try again.
mobile.operationNotAllowed: The current state or access level does not allow this operation.
mobile.similarOperationBusy: A similar session operation is already running.

mobile.operationFailed: The operation did not complete. Check the connection and try again.
mobile.invalidSessionContext: The desktop returned an invalid session context.
mobile.deleteSessionDescription: This removes it from the app session library. A running session must be stopped first.
mobile.archiveSessionDescription: It will be hidden from Projects and Sessions. You can restore it from desktop sidecar metadata if needed.
mobile.noTasksDescription: Running, queued, and completed tasks appear here after you create a session.
mobile.stopTaskDescription: Only this sub-agent will be stopped; the parent session will keep running.
mobile.noPendingRequestsDescription: Questions and permission requests appear here when they need your attention.
mobile.permissionHandledElsewhere: This permission request was handled on desktop or another device.
mobile.permissionSubmitFailed: Could not submit the permission decision. Try again.
mobile.detailsTruncated: Details were truncated to the mobile display limit.
mobile.questionHandledElsewhere: This question was handled on desktop or another device.
mobile.desktopTooOldForCustomAnswer: The desktop version is too old for custom answers or notes.
mobile.answerSubmitFailed: Submission failed. Your answer was kept; try again.
mobile.answerContinuesSession: The desktop session continues after you answer
mobile.otherAnswerHint: If no option is selected, this text is used as the answer
mobile.optionalNotesHint: When an option is selected, this text is sent as notes only
mobile.noSubagentsDescription: Subagents appear here after the session uses the Agent tool.
mobile.sessionModelUnavailable: This session no longer supports model changes.
mobile.configurationUpdatedElsewhere: Configuration changed elsewhere. The latest settings were loaded.

mobile.selectValidConfiguration: Choose a valid Provider, Model, and Effort.

mobile.modelConfigurationUpdated: Model configuration updated. It takes effect on the next message.
mobile.sessionSettingsDescription: Apply Provider, Model, and Effort together. The new configuration starts with the next message and does not interrupt the current response.
mobile.sessionMenuUnavailable: Connect to a newer desktop version to use rename, archive, delete, and other session actions.
mobile.fullSessionAccessRequired: Copying context, branching, and summarizing require full session-content access on desktop.
mobile.sessionLaunchDelayed: The session has not appeared yet. The desktop may be busy; try again.
mobile.invalidLaunchParameters: The launch parameters are invalid. Check them and try again.
mobile.desktopRejectedLaunch: The desktop did not accept this launch. Your request was kept; try again.
mobile.missingJobId: The desktop did not return a task identifier. Try again.
mobile.projectDirectoryHint: To connect a new directory, open or start that project on desktop. It will then appear here automatically.
mobile.taskPromptHint: Describe the task for the Agent…
mobile.desktopDataIncompatible: The desktop version is incompatible with this mobile app, so session data cannot be synchronized. Update desktop and mobile to compatible versions.
mobile.chooseFromGalleryDescription: You can select system screenshots, up to 4 images
mobile.sendFailedCheckStatus: Send failed. Check the session state and try again.

mobile.sendFailedDraftKept: Send failed. Your draft was kept.
mobile.imageUploadFailedDraftKept: Image upload failed. Your draft was kept.
mobile.fullMobileAccessRePair: On desktop, choose Full mobile access in Settings › Devices, then pair again.
mobile.noMessagesDescription: Send a message to continue this session.
mobile.desktopNoImageSupport: This desktop version does not support image input. Update desktop to continue.
mobile.imageLimit: You can add up to 4 images
mobile.fileChangesRequireAccess: File changes require transcript_text and tool_details access.
mobile.noFileChangesDescription: Edit and Write results from this session are summarized here.
mobile.loadedMessagesOnly: Only currently loaded session messages are included
mobile.partialDiffTruncated: Part of the diff was truncated

mobile.subagentCannotReply: This subagent cannot receive replies right now

mobile.noSubagentMessagesDescription: This subagent has not recorded any transcript entries yet.
mobile.composerCommandsDescription: Choose a mobile or session command
